q_45367.question_text: What will be NVIDIA's forward guidance in its Q2 FY2027 earnings release? (Revenue)
q_45367.reasoning:
# Analysis

## (a) Time left until resolution

The earnings release is scheduled for August 26, 2026, after market close. Today is August 22, 2026. **Time remaining: approximately 4 days (or ~96 hours).**

## (b) Most likely outcome and why

The question asks specifically about NVIDIA's **forward guidance** (not actual results) for Q2 FY2027 revenue in the earnings release coming in 4 days.

The research provides critical information:
- NVIDIA already issued guidance on May 20, 2026 for Q2 FY2027: **$91.0 billion ± 2%**
- This implies a range of $89.2 billion to $92.8 billion
- Wall Street consensus across 42 analysts is $91.9 billion (within the guided range)
- Q1 FY2027 actual results were $81.6 billion, beating the prior guidance by ~$2 billion

The most likely outcome is that **NVIDIA will reiterate or slightly adjust its existing $91.0 billion guidance** when it reports Q2 FY2027 results on August 26. Companies typically either:
1. Reiterate previous guidance if nothing material has changed
2. Raise or lower guidance based on business momentum

Given that Q1 beat expectations by ~$2 billion, there is modest upside momentum, but NVIDIA's guidance tends to be reasonably conservative and achievable.

## (c) What would push the value lower?

- Significant deterioration in demand signals between May and August 2026
- Macroeconomic headwinds or AI capex spending slowdown
- Supply chain constraints emerging
- Loss of major customer orders
- Competitive pressure in data center (primary revenue driver)

## (d) What would push the value higher?

- Continued strong demand for GPUs in AI/data center segment
- Q1 beat by ~$2 billion suggests conservative guidance; Q2 could similarly beat
- AI market acceleration exceeding prior forecasts
- Strong customer inventory replenishment demand
- Better-than-expected demand from hyperscalers

## (e) Base rate or historical reference values

From the research provided:
- Q1 FY2027 actual: $81.6 billion (beat guidance by ~$2 billion)
- Q2 FY2027 guidance issued May 20: $91.0 billion ± 2% ($89.2B–$92.8B)
- Wall Street analyst consensus: $91.9 billion

**No other specific historical quarterly guidance patterns provided in the research.**

---

## Probability Distribution Reasoning

The question asks for a **point estimate** (forward guidance figure) on a continuous scale from 99.5B (lower bound, open) to 115.5B (upper bound, open).

Key constraints:
- NVIDIA has already publicly stated guidance of $91.0B ± 2% in May 2026
- This is binding forward guidance issued to the market
- With only 4 days until the earnings call, material changes would be extraordinary
- Companies rarely change guidance dramatically between issuance and earnings release

**Most probable scenario:** NVIDIA reiterates the $91.0B guidance or makes a minor adjustment (+/- $1–2B). The $91.0B midpoint is the single most likely outcome, with the distribution tightly centered around this value.

Given:
- $91.0B is the explicitly stated guidance
- Wall Street consensus is $91.9B (slightly above)
- Q1 beat pattern suggests modest upside bias
- Very little time for material new information

The median should cluster near **$91.0–$91.5 billion**.

For percentiles:
- **10th percentile (downside tail):** ~$89.5B (near lower bound of ±2% range, or slight miss)
- **50th percentile (median):** ~$91.2B (reiteration with slight adjustment or modest outperformance signal)
- **90th percentile (upside tail):** ~$93.5B (elevated guidance reflecting Q1 momentum and strong demand signals)

The range 99.5B–115.5B in the question appears to be asking about possible actual revenues, but the question text asks for "forward guidance" which NVIDIA will announce. The guidance will almost certainly fall in the $89–94B range based on existing public guidance.

---

q_45367.research_text:
NVIDIA is set to release its Q2 FY2027 earnings on August 26, 2026, after market close [morningstar.com](https://www.morningstar.com/stocks/going-into-earnings-is-nvidia-stock-buy-sell-or-fairly-valued-8). For Q2 FY2027, NVIDIA's own guidance, issued on May 20, 2026, predicts revenue of $91.0 billion, plus or minus 2% [investor.nvidia.com](https://investor.nvidia.com/news/press-release-details/2026/NVIDIA-Announces-Financial-Results-for-First-Quarter-Fiscal-2027/), [fool.com](https://www.fool.com/investing/2026/08/19/nvidia-guided-to-usd91-billion-wall-street-penciled-in-usd92-billion/). This guidance implies a ceiling near $92.8 billion and a floor near $89.2 billion [fool.com](https://www.fool.com/investing/2026/08/19/nvidia-guided-to-usd91-billion-wall-street-penciled-in-usd92-billion/).

Wall Street analysts, based on 42 estimates, project an average revenue of $91.9 billion, which falls within NVIDIA's guided range [fool.com](https://www.fool.com/investing/2026/08/19/nvidia-guided-to-usd91-billion-wall-street-penciled-in-usd92-billion/). NVIDIA's Q2 FY2027 outlook explicitly excludes any Data Center compute revenue from China [investor.nvidia.com](https://investor.nvidia.com/news/press-release-details/2026/NVIDIA-Announces-Financial-Results-for-First-Quarter-Fiscal-2027/), a stance consistent with the year-ago quarter [fool.com](https://www.fool.com/investing/2026/08/19/nvidia-guided-to-usd91-billion-wall-street-penciled-in-usd92-billion/). In Q1 FY2027, NVIDIA reported record revenue of $81.6 billion, exceeding its own guidance by about $2 billion [fool.com](https://www.fool.com/investing/2026/08/19/nvidia-guided-to-usd91-billion-wall-street-penciled-in-usd92-billion/).
